xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3197 triage re-enrich (swarm add-on)

plan.title: feat(triage): re-enrich already-triaged issues after policy/rule changes

narratives.Description: After mass SCM label-mirror apply, issues stamped with the idempotency label are skipped_already_triaged forever. That blocks re-enrichment when actionLabels, auto-classify rules, or hold markers change. This story keeps default one-shot skip behavior and adds an explicit opt-in re-enrich path that re-plans already-triaged issues with batched apply.
narratives.UserStory: As a triage operator, I want an opt-in re-enrich mode for already-triaged issues after policy or rule changes, so that new action chips and corrected dispositions can backfill without hand-removing the triaged stamp.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Read packages/core/src/triage/classify/label-mirror.ts skipped_already_triaged path. 2. Keep default apply: already-triaged skips. 3. Add --re-enrich (or final documented flag) dry-run by default; re-classify already-triaged; additive label deltas v1; batch apply; never triage:accept or xBRIEF writes. 4. Dry-run digest first-time vs re-enrich. 5. Tests + CHANGELOG + commands.md; cross-link #3124. Verify: npm test -w @deftai/directive-core -- --run triage/classify/label-mirror.

narrative.Acceptance: Given already-triaged issues and normal apply without re-enrich, when mirror runs, then they remain skipped_already_triaged.
Given re-enrich flag dry-run, when run, then already-triaged issues are re-classified and digest distinguishes re-enrich rows.
Given re-enrich apply, when labels write, then batched rate-limit-aware and never triage:accept or xBRIEF writes.
Given tests and commands.md/CHANGELOG, when reviewed, then skip-default + re-enrich plan covered and #3124 re-run vs re-enrich cross-linked.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: May touch classify help registry. Additive-only v1. Exclusive of policy/#3189 and init-deposit/#3193.
